state_order: The 16 hexadecimal nibbles are in row-major order: positions 4*r+c form row r, column c. Position and round indices are zero based.
round_function: Apply the S-box independently to all 16 nibbles.
For round constant rc, XOR rc&0xf into state[0,0], (rc>>4)&0x3 into state[1,0], and 0x2 into state[2,0].
XOR the first two rows of the current TK1 state into the first two state rows.
For each column with ShiftRows output (x0,x1,x2,x3), MixColumns returns (x0 xor x2 xor x3, x0, x1 xor x2, x0 xor x2).

tk1_schedule.round_key: Round r uses the first two rows of the current TK1 state.
tk1_schedule.permutation_semantics: After each round, next_tk1[i] = current_tk1[permutation[i]]. No LFSR is applied in TK1 mode.

related_key_semantics: The second execution starts from TK1' = TK1 xor the supplied 16-nibble TK1 difference; both TK1 states then use the same permutation schedule.
trail_boundary_semantics: boundary[r] is the state difference immediately before the S-box of round r for r=0..9; boundary[10] is the state difference after round 9 MixColumns.
